messages:
Maria: Quick sync — collecting postmortem action owners for last night's GPU capacity incident. I'm trying to get clear owners + timelines for quota request, scheduler tuning, and headroom planning. I’ll compile into the doc: https://docs.google.com/shared-drive/INTERNAL/pm-gpu-remediations

Devin: I can own scheduler tuning (action: tune binpacking + pod spread). Will prototype config changes and run a 2-hour canary tomorrow. ETA: end of week.

Sophia: I’ll take headroom policy (how much reserve per pool + autoscaler thresholds). Need hourly per-model QPS and percentiles from analytics to set safe thresholds. Can someone dump last 7 days?

Lee: I can pull the telemetry. Will attach the CSV to the doc. Also can export the autoscaler logs for the time window.

Anita: I’ll handle the quota request to cloud procurement. Need exact instance families (A100/T4) and monthly EUs. Maria — can you add the expected sustained and burst numbers to the doc?

Maria: Added initial numbers (sustained: 180 GPUs, burst: 260 GPUs) and a brief rationale. Note: we observed a pattern of weekday afternoon traffic spikes — probably customer batch jobs + internal retraining pipelines.

ops-bot: Incident #2026-03-21-GPU_CAPACITY: channel created, postmortem draft created at https://confluence/internal/pm/gpu-capacity-2026. Auto-attach: incident logs.

Devin: Scheduler note — current binpack threshold is 0.8 which leaves almost no headroom when pods request max. Suggest lowering to 0.65 and enable soft eviction at 0.75 for burst protection. Will test on staging.

Sophia: For headroom policy, proposed rollout: 1) apply conservative thresholds to non-critical pools within 48h, 2) monitor 72h, 3) roll to prod across pools in 2 weeks. OK?

Anita: Quota timeline: cloud approval takes ~5 business days. I'll submit today if Maria confirms the GPU family and monthly projection. If expedited, we can request temporary increases for the next 2 weeks.

Maria: Confirmed families: A100-80GB and T4. Monthly projection updated in doc. Please add resource footprints (vCPU/memory) your workloads need so procurement has accurate request fields.

Lee: Uploading telemetry now. Link in doc under /attachments/telemetry-7d.csv. Also added a quick script to reproduce the steady-state load:
```
# run 100 clients at 16rps each for 90m
python tools/loadgen.py --clients 100 --rps 16 --duration 5400 --model gpt-rr-small
```

Devin: After staging tests, I'll post diff of k8s autoscaler config here. If tests fail, fallback plan is to pin certain high-latency workloads to dedicated pools.

Sophia: One more ask — add a recurring monthly audit to catch regressions in autoscaler thresholds. Should be on infra calendar.

Maria: Agreed. I'll create a recurring ticket (monthly) and assign to Platform oncall. Also creating a 2-week follow-up check-in after rollout.

Anita: Quota request submitted (INC-4567). I'll paste the approval ID when it comes through.

Lee: Telemetry CSV + autoscaler logs attached.

Devin: Scheduling staging window for tuning tests tomorrow 10:00-12:00 PST. Will invite relevant folks.

Sophia: Thanks — will review thresholds and prepare monitoring alerts (token-level latency P95, GPU utilization, pending pods).

Maria: Action summary (added to doc):
- Headroom policy: Sophia — conservative rollout, 48h -> 72h -> 2-week prod (owner: Sophia)
- Scheduler tuning: Devin — prototype + staging canary EOW (owner: Devin)
- Quota request: Anita — submitted, awaiting approval (owner: Anita)
- Telemetry export: Lee — uploaded (owner: Lee)
- Recurring audit: Maria -> create monthly ticket for Platform oncall

Maria: If you add short notes/links in the doc I'll close the loop in ~24h and move into a tracked remediation timeline. Ping me for blockers. :thumbsup:
